race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: Borderline smart at his best, CASTLE COVE looks the one to be with on second start back from an absence. Andrew Balding's improving Lord d'Or is feared most ahead of Tawajjah , who has made an excellent start for current connections. CASTLE COVE (IRE) LORD D'OR (GER) TAWAJJAH (IRE)
